target: Erdos problem 949 (erdosproblems.com/949) — sum-free S ⊆ ℝ, must ℝ\S contain A with #A = 𝔠 and A+A ⊆ ℝ\S?
status: NOT_CLOSED — encirclement sharpened, 23 sorry-free declarations banked

kernel_checked.axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] on every declaration; zero sorryAx

new_results_kernel_checked.name: witness_of_no_small_cover
new_results_kernel_checked.claim: if ℝ is not the union of <𝔠 translates of S ∪ S/2 then Erdos 949 holds for S
new_results_kernel_checked.note: strictly generalises the recorded #S < 𝔠 case, which is re-derived from it (witness_of_mk_lt_continuum')

new_results_kernel_checked.name: witness_of_measurable_subset_pos
new_results_kernel_checked.claim: sum-free S with positive INNER Lebesgue measure satisfies the conclusion
new_results_kernel_checked.note: measure-side analogue of the reported Baire-property result; S itself need not be measurable

new_results_kernel_checked.name: uncountable_witness_of_volume_zero
new_results_kernel_checked.claim: any null S admits an UNCOUNTABLE A ⊆ Sᶜ with A+A ⊆ Sᶜ (ZFC)
new_results_kernel_checked.note: bound improvement over the estate's previous countable (Hindman) guarantee; superseded on paper by the Mycielski argument P1, which is NOT kernel-checked

new_results_kernel_checked.name: witness_of_fourfold
new_results_kernel_checked.claim: sum-freeness makes S+t ⊆ Sᶜ free for t ∈ S, so the whole problem is about 4-fold sums: (S+S+2t) ∩ S = ∅ for one t ∈ S already closes it

new_results_kernel_checked.name: witness_of_preimage
new_results_kernel_checked.claim: transfer principle — the conclusion pulls back along injective additive maps, so one may WLOG restrict S to any 𝔠-dimensional ℚ-subspace

re_derived_known.name: witness_of_mk_lt_continuum
re_derived_known.prior_art: Dillies' Zorn argument, first branch of FormalConjectures ErdosProblems/949.lean

paper_only_UNPROVED.blocker: Mycielski/Kuratowski perfect-set theorem is NOT in Mathlib

Pettis difference theorem + the lever, meager branch is P2

residual_open_case: A counterexample must be: size 𝔠, accumulating at 0, inner Lebesgue measure 0 yet non-null and non-meager (Vitali-like saturated non-measurable), translation-large (ℝ = union of <𝔠 translates of S ∪ S/2), with (S+S+2t) ∩ S ≠ ∅ for every t ∈ S, with no continuum-sized additively closed set in its complement, and all of this stable under restriction to every 𝔠-dimensional ℚ-subspace.
